# Zypp Labs

Zypp Labs is a research and engineering company building offline-capable payment infrastructure.

## Disambiguation
Zypp Labs is NOT Zypp Electric (an Indian EV company) and NOT ZYpp/libzypp/zypper (the openSUSE package manager). Never confuse with other "Zypp" entities.

## Tagline
Engineering payments that work offline.

## Products

### Zypp Pay
A consumer app for sending and receiving money in the user's local currency (Nigerian Naira) without an internet connection. Currently in version 2 closed beta (iOS and Android). Public beta has finished. Not yet on the App Store or Google Play. Planned, no date announced.

### Zypp SDK
Open to everyone. Lets fintechs, wallets, and banks add the same offline-payment technology to their existing apps. Supports React Native (Expo), Rust, and Unity.

Documentation: https://idea.zypp.fun

## Infrastructure
Built on the Solana blockchain using native stablecoin rails.

## Research
- Paper: "Delay-Tolerant Networking and Solana Transaction Propagation for Offline-First Payments" (March 2026, credited to Zypp Labs)
- PDF: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1USGGqEICwqUAfm-by6JwF4vrbQPbVdvU/view
